local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local character=p.Character local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
local function rectFor(cf,size)
 local r={minX=math.huge,minY=math.huge,maxX=-math.huge,maxY=-math.huge,front=0}
 for sx=-1,1,2 do for sy=-1,1,2 do for sz=-1,1,2 do
  local point=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X*sx*.5,size.Y*sy*.5,size.Z*sz*.5)))
  if point.Z>math.max(.05,math.abs(cam.NearPlaneZ))then r.front+=1 end
  r.minX=math.min(r.minX,point.X)r.minY=math.min(r.minY,point.Y)r.maxX=math.max(r.maxX,point.X)r.maxY=math.max(r.maxY,point.Y)
 end end end return r
end
local function overlapRatio(a,b)
 if not a or not b or a.front~=8 or b.front~=8 then return 1 end
 local width=math.max(0,math.min(a.maxX,b.maxX)-math.max(a.minX,b.minX))local height=math.max(0,math.min(a.maxY,b.maxY)-math.max(a.minY,b.minY))
 local areaA=math.max((a.maxX-a.minX)*(a.maxY-a.minY),1)local areaB=math.max((b.maxX-b.minX)*(b.maxY-b.minY),1)
 return width*height/math.min(areaA,areaB)
end
local matrix={}local failures={}local allValid=true
for _,distance in ipairs({6,12,18})do
 local pos=root.Position-root.CFrame.LookVector*distance+Vector3.new(0,2.2,0)local focus=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)local desired=CFrame.lookAt(pos,focus)
 cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.CFrame=desired cam.Focus=CFrame.new(focus)task.wait(1)
 local observedFocus=cam.Focus.Position local studioFocusPlane=desired.Position+desired.LookVector*20
 local requestedFocusDelta=(observedFocus-focus).Magnitude local studioPlaneDelta=(observedFocus-studioFocusPlane).Magnitude
 local focusPolicy=requestedFocusDelta<.001 and 'RequestedFocus' or studioPlaneDelta<.001 and 'ObservedStudio20StudPlane' or 'UnexpectedFocus'
 local acceptedFocus=focusPolicy=='ObservedStudio20StudPlane' and studioFocusPlane or focus
 local focusSetupValid=focusPolicy~='UnexpectedFocus'
 local viewport=cam.ViewportSize local valid=viewport.X>1 and viewport.Y>1 and focusSetupValid local maxAvatarOverlap,maxPairOverlap,minWorldPair=0,0,99 local maxCameraPositionDelta,maxCameraFocusDelta,maxCameraAngleDegrees=0,0,0
 for sample=1,20 do
  task.wait(.15)local avatarCf,avatarSize=character:GetBoundingBox()local avatarRect=rectFor(avatarCf,avatarSize)local pets={}
  for _,m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do if m:IsA('Model')then
   local cf,size=m:GetBoundingBox()table.insert(pets,{name=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName'),position=cf.Position,rect=rectFor(cf,size),formation=m:GetAttribute('FormationPolicy'),size={size.X,size.Y,size.Z},safe=m:GetAttribute('CompanionSafeFrameValid'),shift=m:GetAttribute('CompanionSafeFrameShift')})
  end end
  local avatarOverlap,pairOverlap,worldPair=0,0,99
  for i=1,#pets do
   avatarOverlap=math.max(avatarOverlap,overlapRatio(pets[i].rect,avatarRect))
   for j=i+1,#pets do pairOverlap=math.max(pairOverlap,overlapRatio(pets[i].rect,pets[j].rect))worldPair=math.min(worldPair,(pets[i].position-pets[j].position).Magnitude)end
  end
  local current=cam.CFrame local actualFocus=cam.Focus.Position
  local positionDelta=(current.Position-desired.Position).Magnitude local focusDelta=(actualFocus-acceptedFocus).Magnitude
  local lookDot=current.LookVector:Dot(desired.LookVector)local lookLengths=current.LookVector.Magnitude*desired.LookVector.Magnitude
  local normalizedDot=lookLengths>0 and math.clamp(lookDot/lookLengths,-1,1)or -1
  local angleDegrees=math.deg(math.acos(normalizedDot))
  local cameraMetrics={cameraType=tostring(cam.CameraType),scriptable=cam.CameraType==Enum.CameraType.Scriptable,positionDelta=positionDelta,focusDelta=focusDelta,lookDot=lookDot,lookLengths=lookLengths,angleDegrees=angleDegrees,focusPolicy=focusPolicy,requestedFocusDelta=requestedFocusDelta,acceptedFocus={acceptedFocus.X,acceptedFocus.Y,acceptedFocus.Z},position={current.Position.X,current.Position.Y,current.Position.Z},desiredPosition={desired.Position.X,desired.Position.Y,desired.Position.Z},focus={actualFocus.X,actualFocus.Y,actualFocus.Z},desiredFocus={focus.X,focus.Y,focus.Z}}
  maxCameraPositionDelta=math.max(maxCameraPositionDelta,positionDelta)maxCameraFocusDelta=math.max(maxCameraFocusDelta,focusDelta)maxCameraAngleDegrees=math.max(maxCameraAngleDegrees,angleDegrees)
  local cameraUnchanged=focusSetupValid and cam.CameraType==Enum.CameraType.Scriptable and positionDelta<.001 and lookDot>.999999 and focusDelta<.001
  local sampleValid=#pets==3 and avatarOverlap<=.08 and pairOverlap<=.08 and worldPair>=1.45 and cameraUnchanged
  for _,pet in ipairs(pets)do sampleValid=sampleValid and pet.formation=='BoundsAwarePremiumFormationV2' end
  valid=valid and sampleValid maxAvatarOverlap=math.max(maxAvatarOverlap,avatarOverlap)maxPairOverlap=math.max(maxPairOverlap,pairOverlap)minWorldPair=math.min(minWorldPair,worldPair)
  if not sampleValid and #failures<1 then
   local rows={}for _,pet in ipairs(pets)do table.insert(rows,{name=pet.name,position={pet.position.X,pet.position.Y,pet.position.Z},size=pet.size,rect=pet.rect,safe=pet.safe,shift=pet.shift})end
   table.insert(failures,{distance=distance,sample=sample,avatarRect=avatarRect,avatarPosition={avatarCf.Position.X,avatarCf.Position.Y,avatarCf.Position.Z},avatarSize={avatarSize.X,avatarSize.Y,avatarSize.Z},pets=rows,maxAvatarOverlap=avatarOverlap,maxPairOverlap=pairOverlap,minWorldPair=worldPair,cameraUnchanged=cameraUnchanged,camera=cameraMetrics,viewportX=viewport.X,viewportY=viewport.Y})
  end
 end
 allValid=allValid and valid matrix[tostring(distance)]={valid=valid,samples=20,focusPolicy=focusPolicy,requestedFocusDelta=requestedFocusDelta,acceptedFocus={acceptedFocus.X,acceptedFocus.Y,acceptedFocus.Z},maxCameraPositionDelta=maxCameraPositionDelta,maxCameraFocusDelta=maxCameraFocusDelta,maxCameraAngleDegrees=maxCameraAngleDegrees,maxAvatarOverlap=maxAvatarOverlap,maxPairOverlap=maxPairOverlap,minWorldPair=minWorldPair,viewportX=viewport.X,viewportY=viewport.Y}
end
local formation=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD:GetAttribute('CompanionFormationPolicy')allValid=allValid and formation=='BoundsAwarePremiumFormationV2'
return H:JSONEncode({contractValid=allValid,valid=allValid,formation=formation,matrix=matrix,failures=failures})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local root=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
local matrix={} local failures={} local allValid=true
for _,distance in ipairs({6,12,18})do
 local pos=root.Position-root.CFrame.LookVector*distance+Vector3.new(0,2.2,0) local desired=CFrame.lookAt(pos,root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0))
 cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.CFrame=desired cam.Focus=CFrame.new(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0))task.wait(1)
 local viewport=cam.ViewportSize local inset=math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y)*.01 local valid=viewport.X>1 and viewport.Y>1 local samples=0
 for sample=1,20 do
  task.wait(.15) local count=0
  for _,m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do if m:IsA('Model')then
   count+=1 local cf,size=m:GetBoundingBox()local minX,minY,maxX,maxY=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge local front=0
   for sx=-1,1,2 do for sy=-1,1,2 do for sz=-1,1,2 do
    local point=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X*sx*.5,size.Y*sy*.5,size.Z*sz*.5)))
    if point.Z>0 then front+=1 end minX=math.min(minX,point.X)minY=math.min(minY,point.Y)maxX=math.max(maxX,point.X)maxY=math.max(maxY,point.Y)
   end end end
   local safe=front==8 and minX>=inset and minY>=inset and maxX<=viewport.X-inset and maxY<=viewport.Y-inset
   valid=valid and safe
   if not safe and #failures<6 then table.insert(failures,{distance=distance,sample=sample,name=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName'),minX=minX,minY=minY,maxX=maxX,maxY=maxY,front=front,viewportX=viewport.X,viewportY=viewport.Y,inset=inset})end
  end end
  valid=valid and count==3 and cam.CameraType==Enum.CameraType.Scriptable and (cam.CFrame.Position-desired.Position).Magnitude<.001 samples+=1
 end
 allValid=allValid and valid matrix[tostring(distance)]={valid=valid,samples=samples,inset=inset}
end
return H:JSONEncode({contractValid=allValid,valid=allValid,safe=allValid,matrix=matrix,failures=failures})
